text.content:
A Unstable room, unremarkable at a glance but part of the Cisterns's larger pattern all the same.

GM Notes

Clue: A clue toward the floor's deeper story: a rogue homunculus conclave sealed something down here that was never meant to finish brewing, and the seals are failing.

Encounter: This room refills with a new threat if left and returned to later, on the same table used for the floor's other random encounters.

Hazard: A pressure plate near the threshold triggers a hidden mechanism unless disarmed (DC 13 to notice, DC 13 to disarm).
